create_timeseriesdata_from_dataframe: create a TimeSeriesData object from a pandas DataFrame with a specified time column name
create_timeseriesdata_from_series: create a TimeSeriesData object from separate pandas Series for time and value
extend_timeseriesdata: extend a TimeSeriesData object by concatenating it with another TimeSeriesData object
interpolate_missing_data: interpolate missing data points in a TimeSeriesData object using linear or fill methods
plot_timeseries: plot a time series using matplotlib with optional column selection and grid settings
